<div class="card-body">
'''Victory-Class Star Destroyer''' is a [[Dark]] [[Starship]] ([[Capital]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ヴィクトリー級スター・デストロイヤー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">4名のパイロット、6名の乗客、1台のビークル、3機のTIEを乗せられる。ドッキング能力を持つ。能力値1の専属パイロットが乗っている。同一星系のすべての位置における合計戦闘力が＋1される。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Victory-Class-Star-Destroyer-PSA-135901783.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">クローン・ウォーの末期に旧共和国が発注した。レンディリ製ヴィクトリー級スター・デストロイヤーは、大気圏突入が可能なかわりに、通常航行速度が劣る。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Victory-class Star Destroyer.

'''Card text:'''
May add 4 pilots, 6 passengers, 1 vehicle, and 3 TIEs. Has docking capability. A permanent pilot of ability 1 is aboard. Total power is +1 at every location in the same system.

'''Lore:'''
Ordered by the Old Republic at the end of the Clone Wars. Rendili's Victory-class Star Destroyer can enter atmosphere, but in return its ordinary travel speed is poor.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese adds 1 to total power at every location in the same system.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Victory-Class Star Destroyer]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
